content.text: Change the background color of the snake's tongue to #e03131 (red).
I'll help you change the snake's tongue background color to red. Let me first take a screenshot to see the current state of the page.

This appears to be an Excalidraw drawing of a snake. I can see the snake's body (multiple ellipses), head with eyes on the right, and what looks like a forked tongue extending to the far right. Let me click on the tongue element to select it.

I've selected one part of the tongue (the forked tip). The tongue appears to have multiple parts - the main body extending from the head and the forked tip. Let me select all the tongue parts. First, let me see if I need to select more. The tongue seems to consist of the elongated ellipse and the two forked parts. Let me select all tongue elements by holding shift and clicking the other parts.

Let me first check what's currently selected, then add the other tongue parts. I'll shift-click the main tongue body ellipse.

I now have the two forked tips of the tongue selected. I still need to add the main tongue body (the horizontal ellipse connecting to the head). Let me shift-click on it. Looking at the drawing, the main tongue ellipse is around x=1075.

It seems my last shift-click deselected the forked parts and only the main tongue ellipse is now selected. This might be because clicking on an already-selected element toggles it off, or the click landed differently. Let me start over and select all three tongue parts carefully.

Let me click on empty space first to deselect everything.
Now let me select all the tongue parts. I'll click the main tongue ellipse first, then shift-click each forked tip.

I have the main tongue ellipse selected (the horizontal one connecting to the head). The tongue consists of this main body plus two forked tips. Let me shift-click on both forked tips to add them to the selection.

The upper fork tip is around (1155, 405) and the lower fork tip is around (1155, 445).

Hmm, it seems the selection now shows only the upper fork tip selected, and the main tongue body got deselected. The shift-click behavior seems tricky - it may have toggled off the main body. 

Let me take a different, more reliable approach. Instead of trying to select all parts individually, let me use a drag-selection (rubber band selection) to select the entire tongue area at once. First, let me deselect everything.

Now let me drag-select a box around the entire tongue area. The tongue spans from about x=1030 to x=1190, and y=380 to y=465. I'll start the drag from below-left of the head (avoiding the head) and drag to cover just the tongue.

Now I have all three tongue parts selected (the main body and both forked tips) - I can see the selection box encompassing the entire tongue, and the "Align" panel appeared indicating multiple elements are selected. 

Now I need to set the background color to #e03131. The default background swatches don't have this exact color, so I'll click on the Background color swatch/picker to open the custom color input. Let me click on the rightmost background color box (the active color indicator) to open the color picker.
The color picker is open with a "Hex code" input field showing "transparent". Let me click on the hex code input field and type the new color value.

I see the issue - the triple-click didn't select the text, so it appended to "transparent" resulting in "ranspae03131". Let me clear the field properly. I'll click on the field, select all, and retype.
Browser action failed: Keyboard.press: Unknown key: "ctrl"
The hex code field is now empty (showing just "#"). Now let me type the correct color value.

The tongue background is now filled with red (#e03131). I can see:
- The hex code field shows "e03131"
- The Background color swatch on the left is now red
- All three tongue parts (main body and both forked tips) are now filled with the red color

Let me close the color picker and click on an empty area to deselect, so we can see the final result clearly.

The task is complete. I've successfully changed the background color of the snake's tongue to red (#e03131). 

As you can see in the final result, the snake's forked tongue extending from the head on the right is now filled with the red color (#e03131), while the rest of the snake's body remains uncolored. All three parts of the tongue—the main body and both forked tips—now have the red background fill applied.
